WITH operands AS (
    SELECT id, CASE id WHEN 0 THEN CAST('9223372036854775807' AS BIGINT)
                       WHEN 1 THEN CAST('-9223372036854775807' AS BIGINT)
                       WHEN 2 THEN CAST(NULL AS BIGINT)
                       WHEN 3 THEN CAST(0 AS BIGINT) ELSE i END AS value
    FROM bench WHERE id<8
)
SELECT id,negative(value) AS result FROM operands

WITH operands AS (
    SELECT id, CASE WHEN id=0 THEN CAST('-9223372036854775808' AS BIGINT) ELSE i END AS value
    FROM bench WHERE id<8
)
SELECT id,negative(value) AS result FROM operands

WITH operands AS (
    SELECT id, CASE WHEN id=0 THEN CAST('-9223372036854775808' AS BIGINT) ELSE i END AS value
    FROM bench WHERE id<8
)
SELECT id,CASE WHEN id>0 THEN negative(value) END AS result FROM operands
SELECT id,negative(CAST('-9223372036854775808' AS BIGINT)) AS result FROM bench WHERE id<8

SELECT id,negative(dec) AS decimal_value,negative(CAST('-0.0' AS DOUBLE)) AS floating_value
FROM bench WHERE id<8
SELECT id,negative(i) AS result FROM bench WHERE id<0

WITH operands AS (
    SELECT id, CAST(CASE WHEN id=1 THEN '-128' ELSE CAST(i AS STRING) END AS TINYINT) AS value
    FROM bench WHERE id<8
)
SELECT id,negative(value) AS result FROM operands

WITH operands AS (
    SELECT id, CAST(CASE WHEN id=1 THEN '-32768' ELSE CAST(i AS STRING) END AS SMALLINT) AS value
    FROM bench WHERE id<8
)
SELECT id,negative(value) AS result FROM operands

WITH operands AS (
    SELECT id, CAST(CASE WHEN id=1 THEN '-2147483648' ELSE CAST(i AS STRING) END AS INT) AS value
    FROM bench WHERE id<8
)
SELECT id,negative(value) AS result FROM operands
